objective: Choose the smallest B in the authorized candidate set whose conservative identity-blind power is at least 0.90, then apply the 168-hour stop rule.

frozenScientificDesign.multiplicity: Holm strong FWER across 35 domain-by-comparator hypotheses
frozenScientificDesign.primaryClaimSuccess: at least four of seven domains pass; a domain passes only when all five target-versus-comparator hypotheses in that domain are rejected

frozenMipe.D1: both log geometric-mean elapsed and log P95 elapsed contrasts equal ln(0.90) under the planning alternative
frozenMipe.D2: log geometric-mean grid-access contrast equals ln(0.90)
frozenMipe.D3: log1p(total managed allocation bytes) contrast equals ln(0.90); this is a ratio on the 1+bytes scale and raw-byte interpretation must be reported
frozenMipe.D4: log1p(max persistent-state bytes) contrast equals ln(0.90); this is a ratio on the 1+bytes scale and raw-byte interpretation must be reported
frozenMipe.D5: D1 log-geometric-mean slope difference per log2(agentCount) unit equals ln(0.90)
frozenMipe.D6: D1 log-geometric-mean slope difference per log2(changedCellCount) unit equals ln(0.90)
frozenMipe.D7: D1 log-geometric-mean slope difference per log2(gridEdge^2) unit equals ln(0.90)

endpointConstruction.D3: log1p(sum of counter-valid event-group managedAllocationBytes joined by d3WindowRecordId)
endpointConstruction.D4: log1p(max valid persistentStateBytesTotal over lane measurement points)

nuisanceModel.rows: 648 core lane summaries clustered into 108 independent superblocks
nuisanceModel.estimator: multivariate OLS with superblock-clustered CR1 sandwich covariance
nuisanceModel.covarianceScalingForFormalB: qualification covariance multiplied by qualification B per cell / formal B = 3/B
nuisanceModel.nuisanceUncertaintyInflation: multiply by df/chi-square-lower-0.05(df), with df = number of independent clusters minus model rank and the lower quantile computed by the Wilson-Hilferty approximation
nuisanceModel.identityBlindness: repeat for every possible opaque target label ALG-A through ALG-F, never open the identity map, and use the worst power across the six possibilities

powerAlgorithm.planningAlternative: all 40 primitive target-versus-comparator contrasts are exactly ln(0.90)
powerAlgorithm.primitiveContrasts: 5 comparators x [D1 geometric mean, D1 P95, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D7] = 40
powerAlgorithm.domainPValues: D1 uses the intersection-union maximum of its two one-sided p-values; D2-D7 each use one one-sided p-value, yielding 35 domain-by-comparator hypotheses
powerAlgorithm.simulation: multivariate-normal Monte Carlo from the frozen contrast covariance
powerAlgorithm.powerEstimate: probability that the frozen primary-claim success rule is satisfied
powerAlgorithm.acceptanceCriterion: the minimum across six opaque targets of the two-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound must be at least 0.90
powerAlgorithm.selection: first passing B in ascending order

sevenDayRule.actionIfAtOrAboveThreshold: stop before formal ST freeze and submit a simplification proposal for explicit user authorization
sevenDayRule.actionIfBelowThreshold: eligible to proceed to final formal ST freeze under already-authorized step 8

prohibitions: no named algorithm effect estimation or reporting
no ranking, weighting, or winner decision
no use of qualification observations as formal samples
no effect-size tuning from observed separation
no change to G, N, F, six algorithms, endpoints, majority rule, multiplicity, correctness gates, or oracle gates
no formal collection, MQ, MT, or migration-package build
